title: Security and Simulator-Query Bounds for 3-Round Feistel
summary: For the 3-round Feistel construction, the simulator has quadratic query complexity and birthday-type bounds; improving these bounds or proving matching lower bounds remains open.

formal_statement.body: Improve the security and simulator-query bounds for 3-round Feistel, or prove matching lower bounds.
